title: Ecosystem Actors are the only actors permitted to do work not strictly bounded by the Atlas
content:
A.1.8.1 describes Active or Incubating Ecosystem Actors as working "according to the specifications of the Atlas to receive funding for performing specific projects that benefit the Sky Ecosystem" — development, data analysis, marketing and outreach, education, legal work, government outreach, "and other operational activities." Then the structural clause: "Active and Incubating Ecosystem Actors are the **only** type of actor that is permitted to do work that isn't strictly defined in, and bounded by, the Atlas."

This solves a problem the rest of the framework creates. Alignment Conservers must operate "only within the clearly delineated processes and frameworks of the Immutable Documents" (A.1.5.3), with inferences "maximally grounded" in explicit text. That constraint is deliberate, but it means the actors closest to governance are structurally incapable of doing anything the Atlas has not anticipated — and a real ecosystem constantly needs work no rulebook foresaw.

Rather than loosening the AC constraint, the Atlas designates a separate class where undefined work is legitimate. Open-ended activity is quarantined into a role that does not hold governance power, while the roles holding governance power stay tightly bounded. Flexibility and authority are deliberately kept in different populations.

The trade-off is visible in the same Article. Ecosystem Actors get discretion but are subject instead to conflict-of-interest requirements on specialized roles — the Core Council Risk Advisor "must be held by an entity without involvement in any business, political, or governance-related activities that could create a conflict of interest" (A.1.8.1.1.1), with the same language for the Protocol Security Workstream Lead (A.1.8.1.2.1). Independence substitutes for the procedural constraint ACs operate under.

Read with NR-17, this is also where the framework is thinnest: the class licensed to act outside the Atlas is the class whose misalignment has no defined adjudication process.
description: A.1.8.1 grants Active and Incubating Ecosystem Actors alone the ability to operate outside strict Atlas definition — making them the ecosystem's designated channel for undefined work.
